[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, recorded simply as Digital Loudoun Plaza, could not be confidently matched to a specific building this session. A Baxtel campus table for this operators Loudoun Ashburn Campus, fetched fresh this session, lists at least four separate buildings on Digital Loudoun Plaza itself, Building G at 43940, Building H at 43780, Building J at 44100, and Building K at 44060, each with its own IAD numbered designation. This rows own name carries no building letter to disambiguate it from any of the four, and this session could not confidently place it at one specific address without a precise geocoding tool. No specific address is asserted for this row.
